_comment: Guideline registry (rationale doc step 2.1 + authority hierarchy). Every clinical chunk in chunks.json carries a document_id that MUST exist here. This file is the single source of provenance and priority. To add a guideline: add its registry entry here, then add its chunks to chunks.json.

source_priority._comment: Doc step 11. Higher wins. Priority is applied SECTION-specifically at rerank time, not document-wide: a malaria-programme chunk outranks the STG malaria section, but does not affect UTI retrieval.

documents.title: Ghana Essential Medicines List
documents.clinical_scope: Medicine approval status, level of care, dosage forms/strengths, prescribing restrictions
documents.note: Not a diagnostic guideline. Supports management AFTER a working diagnosis is established.

documents.title: Ghana Integrated Disease Surveillance and Response — Technical Guidelines
documents.authority: Ghana Health Service / Ministry of Health
documents.clinical_scope: Epidemic-prone/notifiable conditions: meningitis, yellow fever, measles, cholera, VHF, ILI
documents.note: Distinguish a SURVEILLANCE case definition from a CLINICAL diagnosis. Meeting a suspected-case definition does not confirm the disease. SUPERSESSION FLAG: this ingested PDF is the 2002 first edition (confirmed against Ghana MOH's own hosted copy). Published literature (Awoonor-Williams et al., BMC Public Health 2015) indicates Ghana revised its IDSR guidelines in 2011; the WHO/AFRO regional guidelines this was adapted from are now in a 3rd edition. Do not treat this as the current national guideline until a newer Ghana-specific edition has been located and compared — confirm with Ghana Health Service / the National Surveillance Unit before relying on this for the current priority-disease list or case definitions.
